name: Keytar Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange keytar with a row of keys, a slim neck and Rotom's lens eyes and grin at its end
entry: It plays power chords at deafening volume. It never stops showing off.
how: Use a Keytar Strap on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Boomburst in this form.
